title: Лист орендодавцю про несправність
task: Напишіть власнику квартири: уже два дні не працює опалення (або протікає кран). Опишіть проблему, попросіть швидко прислати майстра і запропонуйте зручний час.

items: Dear Mr Kowalski,
Hi Anna,
I hope you are well.
I'm writing to let you know that…
The heating hasn't been working since Monday.
The kitchen tap is leaking.
It is getting quite cold in the flat.
I have tried … but it did not help.
Could you please send someone to fix it as soon as possible?
I am available on … after 5 pm.
Please let me know when would suit you.
Thank you in advance.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Best regards,
Kind regards,

sample:
Dear Mr Kowalski,

I hope you are well. I'm writing to let you know that the heating in our flat hasn't been working since Monday. We have checked the thermostat, but it didn't help, and it is getting quite cold, especially at night.

Could you please send someone to fix it as soon as possible? We are at home every day after 5 pm and all day on Saturday.

Thank you in advance.

Best regards,
Pavlo

title: Запрошення друга на вихідні
task: Напишіть другові неформальне повідомлення: запросіть на барбекю або в похід у суботу, скажіть, о котрій і де, що взяти з собою, і попросіть підтвердити.

items: Hey Tom!
Hi guys,
How's it going?
Long time no see!
Are you free on Saturday?
We're having a barbecue at our place.
Do you fancy going hiking in the Tatras?
It would be great to catch up.
We're starting at around 4.
Just bring something to drink.
We can pick you up if you like.
Let me know if you can make it!
Hope to see you there!
Cheers,

sample:
Hey Tom!

Long time no see! Are you free on Saturday? We're having a barbecue at our place from around 4 pm. Just bring something to drink — we'll take care of the food.

Let me know if you can make it!
Cheers,
Pavlo

title: Скарга в інтернет-магазин
task: Ви отримали замовлення, але товар пошкоджений (або прийшов не той розмір). Напишіть у службу підтримки: номер замовлення, що не так, чого ви хочете (заміна чи повернення грошей).

items: Dear Customer Service,
I am writing to complain about my recent order (No. …).
Unfortunately, the item arrived damaged.
I received the wrong size.
The package was opened when it arrived.
I have attached some photos.
I would like a replacement as soon as possible.
I would prefer a full refund.
Could you please arrange a free return?
I look forward to your reply.
Thank you for your help.
Yours sincerely,
Kind regards,

sample:
Dear Customer Service,

I am writing to complain about my recent order (No. 48213), which arrived yesterday. Unfortunately, the coffee machine was damaged — the water tank is cracked. I have attached some photos.

I would prefer a full refund. Could you please arrange a free return?

I look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
Pavlo Zhyhalov

title: Відгук про ресторан або готель
task: Напишіть відгук на TripAdvisor / Google про місце, де ви нещодавно були: що сподобалося, що ні, кому порадите.

items: We had dinner here last Friday.
Overall, we had a great time.
It was a bit disappointing, to be honest.
The food was delicious, especially…
The staff were friendly and helpful.
The service was quite slow.
It is a bit pricey, but worth it.
I would definitely recommend it.
Perfect for a romantic dinner.
I would not go back.
Make sure you book a table in advance.

sample:
We had dinner here last Friday to celebrate our anniversary. The food was delicious, especially the duck, and the staff were friendly and helpful. The only downside was that the service was quite slow when it got busy.

It's a bit pricey, but definitely worth it. Perfect for a special occasion — just make sure you book a table in advance.

title: Подяка за гостинність
task: Ви гостювали у знайомих. Напишіть теплу подяку: що сподобалось найбільше і запросіть їх у відповідь.

items: Thank you so much for having us.
We had a wonderful time.
It was so kind of you to…
The dinner was amazing.
We loved the walk by the lake.
The kids are still talking about it.
Next time you must come to us!
You are always welcome in Kraków.
Let us know when you are free.

sample:
Hi Kate and Ben,

Thank you so much for having us last weekend! We had a wonderful time — the dinner was amazing and we loved the walk by the lake.

Next time you must come to us. You're always welcome in Kraków!

Love,
Pavlo & Vita

title: Запит про курс або послугу
task: Напишіть офіційний лист у школу (спортзал, туристичну агенцію): запитайте про розклад, ціну, знижки і як записатися.

items: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to enquire about…
I saw your advertisement on…
Could you tell me when the classes start?
How much does the course cost?
Are there any discounts for…?
Is it possible to join a trial lesson?
I would be grateful for any further information.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,

sample:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to enquire about your evening Spanish course for beginners, which I saw on your website.

Could you tell me when the next course starts and how much it costs? Are there any discounts for couples? Also, is it possible to join a trial lesson first?

I would be grateful for any further information.

Yours faithfully,
Pavlo Zhyhalov

title: Робоче: запит ціни постачальнику
task: Попросіть у нового постачальника комерційну пропозицію: кількість, матеріал, вимоги до якості, бажаний термін, попросіть зразки.

items: Dear Mr Novak,
I am writing on behalf of…
We are looking for a reliable supplier of…
Could you send us a quote for 500 pieces?
Please find the drawings attached.
Our target lead time is 4 weeks.
Would it be possible to get samples first?
We would appreciate your reply by Friday.
Please let me know if you need any further information.
Best regards,

sample:
Dear Mr Novak,

We are looking for a reliable supplier of machined aluminium parts. Could you please send us a quote for 500 pieces of the part in the attached drawing (material 6061-T6, anodized black)?

Our target lead time is 4 weeks. Would it be possible to get 5 samples first?

We would appreciate your reply by Friday. Please let me know if you need any further information.

Best regards,
Pavlo Zhyhalov

title: Робоче: відповідь на скаргу клієнта
task: Клієнт скаржиться на пошкоджений товар. Вибачтеся, поясніть, що ви робите, і запропонуйте рішення.

items: Thank you for letting us know.
Please accept our apologies for the inconvenience.
We are sorry to hear that…
We are looking into the cause.
We will send a replacement free of charge.
To prevent this in future, we have…
Please do not hesitate to contact me.
Thank you for your understanding.
Kind regards,

sample:
Dear Ms Smith,

Thank you for letting us know, and please accept our apologies for the inconvenience. We are sorry to hear that the product arrived damaged.

We will send a replacement free of charge today, and we are looking into the cause with our logistics partner.

Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.

Kind regards,
Pavlo Zhyhalov
